items.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4
items.summary: GPT-5.4 is a frontier model for professional work offered as GPT-5.4 Thinking and GPT-5.4 Pro in ChatGPT, the API and Codex, with native computer use, tool search and up to 1M tokens of context. OpenAI reported record results on OSWorld-Verified and 83% on GDPval.
